Rates & Conditions
Residential Rates
Connexus Energy residential rates include the following:
Basic Service Charge
$16.50 per month
Energy Charge (kWh)
$0.1390 June – September
$0.1290 October – May
Power Cost Adjustment (PCA)
-$0.002510 September
$0.001421 October
The Power Cost Adjustment (PCA) accounts for the fluctuations in power supply expenses, which can be a charge or a credit. Power supply expenses are dependent on fuel costs, wholesale market prices, power demand and customer usage. It is important to note that there is no markup for Connexus Energy with the PCA, which is implemented by most utilities statewide and nationwide.

Rates & Conditions
your most powerful membership®
These four words focus on the most important component of our cooperative: our members. In a cooperative, everything we do is for the benefit of our membership. This vision provides daily inspiration to build powerful partnerships with our members.
Fall Savings
Receive a $25 rebate on qualifying Wi-Fi thermostats.
Your Voice Matters
Randomly selected members will receive a quarterly survey by email.
New Payment Option
You can pay your electric bill using an American Express card.
$2,000 Donated Each Month
Vote monthly or nominate a nonprofit serving our community.
Contact Connexus Energy
Get in touch with Connexus Energy. Call, email, stop in, or fill a form with your questions and feedback.

Residential Rates
Connexus Energy residential rates include the following:
Basic Service Charge
$16.50 per month
Energy Charge (kWh)
$0.1390 June – September
$0.1290 October – May
Power Cost Adjustment (PCA)
-$0.002510 September
$0.001421 October
The Power Cost Adjustment (PCA) accounts for the fluctuations in power supply expenses, which can be a charge or a credit. Power supply expenses are dependent on fuel costs, wholesale market prices, power demand and customer usage. It is important to note that there is no markup for Connexus Energy with the PCA, which is implemented by most utilities statewide and nationwide.

As part of our strategic initiatives, we are committed to environmental leadership. Pursuing renewable energy alternatives and giving members the choice to support those initiatives is the right thing to do. With a wide variety of commercial and residential programs, we will partner with you in your efforts to go green, whether at home or at work.

Business Rates
Business Rates
Connexus Energy business rates include the following:
Small Commercial
This rate is available to small commercial services with peak demand that has not exceeded 25 kilowatts (kW) for the preceding 12 months.
Basic Service Charge
$16.50 per month
Energy Charge (kWh)
$0.1390 June - September
$0.1290 October - May
Power Cost Adjustment (PCA)
-$0.002510 September
$0.001421 October
General Commercial
This rate generally applies to non-residential single-phase and three-phase members; this rate does not include irrigation accounts.
Basic Service Charge
$41.00 per month
Demand Charge (kW)
$15.70 June - September
$12.30 October - May
Energy Charge (kWh)
$0.0680 First block 400 kWh per kW of demand
$0.0580 Second block remaining
Power Cost Adjustment (PCA)
-$0.002510 September
$0.001421 October

Business Rates
your most powerful membership®
These four words focus on the most important component of our cooperative: our members. In a cooperative, everything we do is for the benefit of our membership. This vision provides daily inspiration to build powerful partnerships with our members.
Fall Savings
Receive a $25 rebate on qualifying Wi-Fi thermostats.
Your Voice Matters
Randomly selected members will receive a quarterly survey by email.
New Payment Option
You can pay your electric bill using an American Express card.
$2,000 Donated Each Month
Vote monthly or nominate a nonprofit serving our community.
Contact Connexus Energy
Get in touch with Connexus Energy. Call, email, stop in, or fill a form with your questions and feedback.

Electric Vehicles
As part of our strategic initiatives, we are committed to environmental leadership. Pursuing renewable energy alternatives and giving members the choice to support those initiatives is the right thing to do. With a wide variety of commercial and residential programs, we will partner with you in your efforts to go green, whether at home or at work.

Business Rates
Business Rates
Connexus Energy business rates include the following:
Small Commercial
This rate is available to small commercial services with peak demand that has not exceeded 25 kilowatts (kW) for the preceding 12 months.
Basic Service Charge
$16.50 per month
Energy Charge (kWh)
$0.1390 June - September
$0.1290 October - May
Power Cost Adjustment (PCA)
-$0.002510 September
$0.001421 October
General Commercial
This rate generally applies to non-residential single-phase and three-phase members; this rate does not include irrigation accounts.
Basic Service Charge
$41.00 per month
Demand Charge (kW)
$15.70 June - September
$12.30 October - May
Energy Charge (kWh)
$0.0680 First block 400 kWh per kW of demand
$0.0580 Second block remaining
Power Cost Adjustment (PCA)
-$0.002510 September
$0.001421 October

your most powerful membership®
These four words focus on the most important component of our cooperative: our members. In a cooperative, everything we do is for the benefit of our membership. This vision provides daily inspiration to build powerful partnerships with our members.
Fall Savings
Receive a $25 rebate on qualifying Wi-Fi thermostats.
Your Voice Matters
Randomly selected members will receive a quarterly survey by email.
New Payment Option
You can pay your electric bill using an American Express card.
$2,000 Donated Each Month
Vote monthly or nominate a nonprofit serving our community.
Contact Connexus Energy
Get in touch with Connexus Energy. Call, email, stop in, or fill a form with your questions and feedback.
